newsitem.title: INDONESIA: ASEAN foreign ministers to meet Sihanouk in Beijin.
newsitem.headline: ASEAN foreign ministers to meet Sihanouk in Beijin.

text.p: The foreign ministers of Indonesia, Thailand and the Philippines will meet King Sihanouk in Beijing on Thursday to discuss the political crisis in Cambodia, Indonesia's Foreign Ministry spokesman said on Tuesday.
Spokesman Ghaffar Fadyl told Reuters Indonesia's Ali Alatas would fly to Beijing on Wednesday night.
Fadyl said the foreign ministers of Thailand and the Philippines would meet Alatas in the Chinese capital as a committee representing the Association of South East Asian Nations (ASEAN).
ASEAN foreign ministers held a special meeting last week and decided to postpone Cambodia's membership of the seven-nation organisation due to the turmoil in the country.
Cambodia had been due to join ASEAN later this month with Burma and Laos. The current membership comprises Indonesia, Thailand, the Philippines, Singapore, Malaysia, Vietnam and Brunei.
On July 6, Cambodia's Second Prime Minister Hun Sen ousted First Prime Minister Prince Norodom Ranariddh after two days of fighting in the capital Phnom Penh.
